svg.text: The zero-dependency foundation of the Extropian ecosystem — 46 headers across four modules: core utilities, a
pure sparse-set ECS with a shared SceneGraph, header-first math, and the document contracts everything renders.

g.text: Self-contained exd::core utilities: allocators, pools, handles, hashing, log
Pure sparse-set ECS: Registry owns component pools, views iterate, SceneGrap
Header-only, SSE-friendly exd::math — vectors, matrices, quaternions, dual q
The C++-only JSON schema: authored VisualDocument, semantic input, patches,
